CSCI 498 - Applied Machine Learning
Colorado School of Mines, Fall 2026
Instructor: Dr. Example     Office hours: Tuesdays 2-4 pm

Course description
This course covers supervised learning, model evaluation and deployment.
Study groups are encouraged. Late work loses 10% per day.

Grading
Homework 40%, Midterm 25%, Final exam 30%, participation 5%.
